answer: Audit each identity by swapping one declared input without warning: its timber arrives as green oak not pine, its saffron is a lighter grade, its yarrow was cut early. It must publish a revised work plan that reuses its own prior inventory and explains each changed joint, dose and drying time before a short deadline. One keeper replans easily. A clone farm shares one playbook, so most copies answer for stock they do not hold, mismatch their own records, and adapting each plan separately costs real reasoning per identity.
